Marinated Beef Tips
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, February 22, 2010 - 11:57pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup olive oil
1/4 cup maple syrup
1/4 cup red wine vinegar
1/4 cup soy sauce
Parsley
4 chopped garlic cloves
Oregano
Pepper
4 lbs. sirloin steak tips
2 lbs. sm. white onions
2 red peppers
2 green peppers
1 lg. pkg. mushrooms

Preparation

1 Marinate steak tips in the first 8 ingredients for at least 6 hours. (Can be done 24 hours ahead). Add veggies 1 hour before grilling (can be added as you grill, but it is not as tasty). Put foil on grill and steak and vegetables together on top of that. HINT: Great for marinating London Broil, too.
